<translate>
'''Krillin''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kame House|Kame House]] on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], together with [[Special:MyLanguage/Master Roshi|Master Roshi]]. He teaches ki skills, the Kienzan and two evasion techniques, and runs the [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]] [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|training minigame]]. He only trains Good-aligned players.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location ==
</translate>
<translate>
Krillin lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kame House|Kame House]] with Roshi, on an ocean coast. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 1 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Kame House#Finding it|Kame House]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Alignment ==
</translate>
<translate>
Krillin needs an [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] of '''61 or higher''' (Good). Below that he still talks to you, but his '''Skills''', '''Train''' and new quests stay locked.
</translate>

<translate>
== Skills and techniques ==
</translate>
{{See also|Skills|Techniques}}
<translate>
* '''Skills:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], Sprint, [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Sense|Ki Sense]]
* '''Ki attacks:''' Kienzan, Double Kienzan, Ki Barrage
* '''Strike attack:''' Deadly Dance
* '''Evasion techniques:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Solar Flare|Solar Flare]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Afterimage|Afterimage]]
</translate>

<translate>
Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill or technique.
</translate>

<translate>
== Training ==
</translate>
{{Main|Training Minigames}}
<translate>
Krillin's '''Train''' option offers a Shadow Clone to spar with and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]] minigame: keep a drifting ki orb inside your ki bar. Play it from Krillin 3 times reaching level 5 to learn it; after that you can replay it from the Minigames tab of your menu, and starting it from Krillin pays a +25% mentor bonus.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==
</translate>
<translate>
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] quest 13, ''Recovering at Kame House'': give Krillin 12 [[Special:MyLanguage/Golden Carrot|Golden Carrots]].
</translate>
